top.title: Pixalate Releases Q2 2026 Web Seller Trust Index 2.0: 15.3% of Global Authorized Web Inventory Is Resold Through Arbitrage, Down From 20.8% in Q1; Index Exchange Again Top ‘Direct’ Seller in the US, OpenX No. 1 in Germany

The share of mobile sellers primarily acting as arbitrageurs decreased globally from 31.7% to 29.5%, with notable improvements in the US market dropping from 22% to 16%.
